scope: Proposition 12.1 (The inequality for a harmonically flat end) of the manuscript “Conformal flow and the Riemannian Penrose inequality with minimizing frontiers” (preprints/Conformal-flow-and-the-Riemannian-Penrose-inequality-with-minimizing-frontiers-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d49778ad5b338b57), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 52. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (E, h) satisfy the hypotheses of Theorem 1.1, with n ≥ 8, nonempty frontier of full area A, and a harmonically flat end. Then mADM(h) ≥ 1 2 (A/ω)d/(n−1) .
